##### Project general facts

Al Waleed W.S 1 is a contemporary residential building that blends architectural simplicity with functional elegance. A calm design language, neutral tones and generous balconies create a modern, welcoming character, while smart layouts make the most of space and natural light. The building rises above a basement, a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to twelve residential floors and a rooftop, and offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments designed for families, couples and professionals.

Amenities support a comfortable and balanced everyday routine. Residents can enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with open views over the surrounding community, together with a fully equipped indoor gym for daily workouts. Retail and food and beverage outlets at ground level add everyday convenience close to home. Covered parking, district cooling and energy-efficient lighting are integrated throughout the building, supporting a practical, comfortable and more sustainable way of living for residents.

Interiors combine contemporary finishes with practical details. Studios feature spacious balconies, fitted wardrobes and decorative wall cabinets, while one-bedroom apartments offer a choice of open or closed kitchens. Two-bedroom homes include two en-suite bathrooms, a guest washroom, a dedicated laundry room and a closed kitchen for added privacy. Large balconies extend the living space outdoors, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand Residence Complex is a residential community within the wider Dubailand district, set along Dubai–Al Ain Road directly opposite Dubai Silicon Oasis. It offers a calmer suburban setting with apartment buildings, parks and everyday services, while keeping some of Dubai's best-known leisure destinations within easy reach. Dubai Outlet Mall and Lulu Hypermarket are only a short drive away, covering shopping and daily essentials.

Dubai–Al Ain Road, Emirates Road and Oud Metha Road provide quick connections to Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport and Business Bay. Global Village, Dubai Miracle Garden and Arabian Ranches are close by, and schools, clinics and supermarkets are spread across the surrounding communities, making daily life convenient for families and professionals. Dubai Silicon Oasis adds further offices, retail and dining just across the road.

Dubailand Residence Complex is a freehold area that attracts first-time buyers and investors looking for accessible entry points close to Dubai's main road network. Steady demand from young professionals and small families supports rental yields that compare well with more central districts. Continued development of neighbouring communities strengthens the area's appeal for long-term ownership and rental income, especially among buyers working in nearby business districts.
